topics.topic: Whether the proc filesystem path is held by the runner or supplied explicitly through runner_arguments
questions: Must the program be allowed to hold the proc filesystem path needed to list its processes and task directories, or must runner_arguments provide that path in the configuration?
Must the runner be allowed to hold the proc mount path itself, or must runner_arguments provide an explicitly identified proc path in the configuration?

quotes: the program takes every fact of one execution from its command line as runner_arguments builds it, so the text is the same for every execution and holds no list, bound, path or descriptor number of its own.

On os.fork and on starting a thread the audit hook MUST count the tasks by listing the task directory of every process the environment's proc lists, opening no file there — an open outside the exchange directory and the readable_paths is itself a trap hit —, and, when the new task would exceed process_count, write a resource hit to the channel and raise, so the execution concludes resource_exhausted even when the code catches the error; a creation the outer limit refuses is reported the same way (A03 required test 2).

runner_arguments: [BEHAVIOR] MUST return exactly two arguments: the decimal number launch.channel_fd, the descriptor the program writes every message to, which is the parent's own pipe end inherited at that number; and one JSON text with the members exchange_directory, code_file, inputs (each port, carriage, cardinality and files), output_ports (each name, carriage and cardinality), and memory_bytes, process_count and output_bytes of launch.bounds; its member file_size_limit is the imported RELEASE_CEILING_SANDBOX_SCRATCH_BYTES_MAX constant; its member environment is the imported SANDBOX_ENVIRONMENT constant; its member readable_paths is the imported SANDBOX_RUNTIME_PATHS constant; its member raise_on_call is the imported SANDBOX_TRAPPED_FUNCTIONS constant; its member raise_without_argument is the imported SANDBOX_TRAPPED_WITHOUT_ARGUMENT constant; its member raise_on_every_method is the imported SANDBOX_TRAPPED_CLASS constant; its member raise_unseeded is the imported SANDBOX_UNSEEDED_CONSTRUCTOR constant; the program reads exactly these two arguments after its own path.
judgement.why: The runner must know a proc filesystem path to perform the mandated listing, but its source may hold no path and the exhaustively specified configuration provides no identified proc path.
